title: Whale Rock, Coatue suffer big losses in July
excerpt: Alex Sacerdote's $19 billion firm had been one of the best-performing funds in the industry coming into July.
content_html:
AI stock sell-off slams stockpicking hedge funds as Whale Rock loses 21.7% in July

By Bradley Saacks

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

While Leopold Aschenbrenner's 67% loss last month might have had the industry's most severe drawdown in July, plenty of stockpickers focused on cutting-edge companies also suffered.

Alex Sacerdote's Whale Rock Capital was down 21.7% in its flagship fund in July, a person close to the Boston-based manager told Business Insider. The firm had been riding high coming into the month, and July's losses put the fund's gains at 35.1% for the year. That's a sharp decline from the 72.5% return it had through June.

The manager, which turned 20 years old this year, was down 18.8% in its long-only fund last month, the person said. That fund is still up 36.8% in 2026.

July was a tough month for AI and semiconductor stocks. Names like SanDisk, Bloom Energy, and CoreWeave tanked in mid-July amid

jitters in Asian markets

. Mega-cap stocks like Google and Meta also faced minor sell-offs as investors worry about continued spending on AI.

The $19 billion firm added to its stakes in SanDisk and Bloom Energy in the first quarter, according to regulatory filings.

A spokesperson for Whale Rock declined to comment.

Meanwhile, Philippe Laffont's Coatue Management lost 8.3% in July, paring back gains the firm had made on the year. The tech-focused firm's 2026 gains now stand at 14.3%.

Marshall Wace's long-short fund Eureka, meanwhile, was down 6.9% in July, putting its year-to-date gains at 11.6%.

The firms' results may have been even worse if Citadel had not purchased the bulk of Aschenbrenner's public equity portfolio. Situational Awareness, Aschenbrenner's young fund, had juiced bets on artificial-intelligence-linked companies with borrowed money from bank partners.

The sell-off in many AI stocks forced Aschenbrenner to find a buyer to meet his lenders' margin calls. After news of Citadel's purchase circulated throughout the investment industry, many AI stocks rallied, though not enough to erase the losses from the previous weeks.

content_html_zh:
Whale Rock 7 月份下跌 21.7%，AI 股票抛售重挫选股对冲基金

作者：Bradley Saacks 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

虽然利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 上个月的亏损 67% 可能是该行业 7 月份最严重的跌幅，但许多专注于尖端公司的选股者也遭受了损失。

一位接近波士顿经理的人士告诉 Business Insider，Alex Sacerdote 旗下的 Whale Rock Capital 7 月份旗舰基金下跌了 21.7%。 该公司进入本月以来一直处于高位，7 月份的亏损使得该基金全年的涨幅为 35.1%。 这比 6 月份 72.5% 的回报率大幅下降。

这位知情人士称，这位今年已满 20 岁的经理人上个月其只做多的基金下跌了 18.8%。 该基金到 2026 年仍上涨 36.8%。

对于人工智能和半导体股票来说，七月是艰难的一个月。 SanDisk、Bloom Energy 和 CoreWeave 等公司在 7 月中旬遭遇重挫。

jitters in Asian markets

. 由于投资者担心人工智能方面的持续支出，谷歌和 Meta 等大型股票也面临小幅抛售。

根据监管文件，这家价值 190 亿美元的公司在第一季度增持了 SanDisk 和 Bloom Energy 的股份。

鲸鱼岩发言人拒绝置评。

与此同时，Philippe Laffont 的 Coatue Management 7 月份下跌了 8.3%，削减了该公司今年的收益。 这家以科技为重点的公司 2026 年的收益目前为 14.3%。

与此同时，Marshall Wace 的多空基金 Eureka 7 月份下跌 6.9%，今年迄今的涨幅为 11.6%。

如果 Citadel 没有购买 Aschenbrenner 的大部分公共股权投资组合，这些公司的业绩可能会更糟。 阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 的年轻基金 Situational Awareness 通过从银行合作伙伴那里借来的资金，对与人工智能相关的公司进行了大量押注。

许多人工智能股票的抛售迫使阿申布伦纳寻找买家来满足贷方的追加保证金要求。 Citadel 收购的消息传遍整个投资行业后，许多人工智能股票出现反弹，但不足以抹去前几周的损失。
